title: A gut resident
hook: Compare the effects on both participants.

knows: Ecological interactions can affect participants differently.
doesNotKnow: The parasite benefits while the host is harmed. That pattern is parasitism in the stated model.

misconception: An interaction must affect both participants in the same way.
objective: Classify the stated effects of an ecological interaction.

claims.text: Question, diagram and reveal: A tapeworm obtains nutrients from a host and, in this example, harms the host. Using + for benefit, − for harm and 0 for no appreciable effect, which signs describe Tapeworm and Host, in that order? Tapeworm: +; Host: −. The parasite benefits while the host is harmed. That pattern is parasitism in the stated model.
claims.source: Stipulated simplified example; ecological definitions: OpenStax https://openstax.org/books/biology-2e/pages/45-6-community-ecology

claims.text: Icons and signs summarize the stipulated interaction and do not quantify fitness or capture every ecological effect.
Recall: What term describes the Tapeworm–Host interaction as stated in the lesson? The parasite benefits while the host is harmed. That pattern is parasitism in the stated model.
